attributes.board_name: Arkansas State Medical Board – Occupational Therapy Examining Committee

rules.accepted_credit_types: CE must directly pertain to occupational therapy; the Committee does not pre-approve programs. See the Board's Guidelines for Acceptable Continuing Education.
rules.audit_note: Random audits are performed monthly; audited licensees must submit certificates of CE completion.
rules.legal_basis: Arkansas State Medical Board Regulation 6 (Occupational Therapists); Ark. Code Ann. §17-88
rules.notes: Annual online renewal during the birth month; the license expires at midnight on the last day of the birth month. The 10 hours must be earned between the day after last year's birth month and the last day of the current birth month. Renewal fees are waived for active-duty military.
rules.rule_quote: Question: How many CEU’s are required for an Occupational Therapist? Answer: 10 hours per renewal period.
